TV-1 has a two-credential reader: the door opens only when two different credentials with TV-1 access are presented within 15 seconds. shared.body: (a) Work in TV-1 needs two people who each hold current vault-handling certification. Each presents a different credential at the two-credential reader, and both stay until the work is finished and leave together. (b) No person may present more than one credential at the reader. (c) Spare cards are kept in the NOC key cabinet, which releases a card only against the PIN of a person whose badge opens TV-1. A certified operator may release a spare card for a certified colleague whose own badge will not open TV-1, and must write the holder's name, the time and the reason on the paper spare-card register. The holder keeps the card until it is returned to the cabinet.
